newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE police target grooms to curb wedding gunfire.
newsitem.headline: UAE police target grooms to curb wedding gunfire.

text.p: Police in the tiny Gulf backwater of Ras al-Khaimah are to try a drastic new tactic to stop traditional celebratory gunfire at weddings after frequent accidents, the daily Emirates News said on Monday.

"Police will call the would-be groom one day before the marriage ceremony to write a personal commitment that he is fully responsible for any shooting case reported during the marriage ceremony," the paper said.
It said police in the United Arab Emirates sheikhdom had already tried confiscating weapons and arresting their owners to curb shooting at parties, but the practice continued.
